import sys, json, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot()
def obs(): return r.get_obs(cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),include_depth=True,video='none')
def run(name,left=None,right=None):
 o=obs(); p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float); a=np.r_[p[14:21],p[6],p[21:28],p[13]]
 if left: a[:3]=left[:3];a[7]=left[3] if len(left)>3 else 1
 if right:a[8:11]=right[:3];a[15]=right[3] if len(right)>3 else 1
 print('ACTION',name,a.tolist(),flush=True)
 z=r.submit('ee_pose',a,video='none',cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),include_depth=True,note=name)
 z.save('/app/runs/'+name)
 print('META',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in z.meta.items() if k not in ('cameras','proprio')},indent=2),flush=True)
 print('NOW',z.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now'),flush=True)
 return z
if __name__=='__main__':
 name=sys.argv[1]; args=list(map(float,sys.argv[2:]))
 run(name,args[:4],args[4:8])

def close_grippers(name='close'):
 o=obs();p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'],float);a=p[:14].copy(); seq=[]
 for g in np.linspace(1,0,25):
  q=a.copy();q[6]=g;q[13]=g;seq.append(q)
 for _ in range(6):seq.append(seq[-1].copy())
 z=r.submit('joint_position',np.array(seq),dt=0.04,video='none',cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),include_depth=True,note=name)
 z.save('/app/runs/'+name)
 print('META',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in z.meta.items() if k not in ('cameras','proprio')},indent=2),flush=True)
 print('CMD',z.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[])[:14],flush=True)
 print('MEAS',z.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[])[30:44],flush=True)
 return z
